## 2. Core Service Tiers & Solutions

Levente offers software development, backend automation, and Discord bot solutions:

### 01 // Full-Stack Software & Web Development
- Description: End-to-end web applications, reactive user interfaces, and robust backend systems engineered for speed, security, and maintainability.
- Capabilities:
  - Modern frontend development with Next.js (App Router, Server Components), React 19, TypeScript, and semantic CSS token design systems.
  - High-performance asynchronous backend microservices with Python, FastAPI, Uvicorn, and REST API design.
  - Relational database modeling with SQLite (WAL mode for zero-latency local caching) and PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy / Drizzle ORM.
  - Multi-process desktop application engineering with Electron and native IPC communication.
- Typical Timelines: 2 to 4 weeks for MVPs, 1 to 2 months for full production systems.

### 02 // Backends & Automation
- API integrations, data-processing pipelines, and background services using Python and TypeScript.

### 03 // Discord Bot Development & Automation
- Description: Custom event-driven Discord bots engineered for community engagement, automated server administration, and business workflow integration.
- Capabilities:
  - Event loop architecture with Python (discord.py) or Node.js.
  - Real-time activity telemetry, leveling systems, and ranking engines.
  - Automated moderation, anti-spam filters, and verification gates.
  - Embedded SQLite / PostgreSQL persistence for user state and audit logs.
  - Optional companion administrative web dashboards.

### 04 // Custom & Hybrid Architecture
- Description: Custom integrations connecting backend services, Discord bots, and web applications.

## 3. Detailed Architectural Case Study: Swaya Media Manager

- Project URL: https://leventegall.dev/projects/swaya
- Classification: Full-Stack Desktop Media Management Application
- Architecture:
  - Frontend: React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS design tokens.
  - Desktop Container: Electron multi-process runtime with strict Context Isolation and secure IPC bridge.
  - Backend Engine: Python, FastAPI daemon running locally on an isolated loopback port.
  - Media Streaming: MPV media player controlled via native IPC socket pipes.
  - Database: SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode for concurrent read/write transactions and zero network latency.
- Key Challenges Solved:
  - Decoupling the UI layer from heavy file scanning and metadata extraction using asynchronous Python background workers.
  - Real-time bi-directional telemetry between the Electron main process, FastAPI background daemon, and React HUD renderer.
  - Offline-first architecture requiring zero external cloud dependencies.

## 4. Technical Stack & Engineering Matrix

### Programming Languages
- Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, Asyncio, Pydantic)
- TypeScript & JavaScript (ESNext, React 19, Next.js, Node.js)
- C (Systems programming, scientific computing)
- SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite, complex joins, index optimization)
- HTML5 & CSS3 (Semantic markup, modern layout models, tokenized CSS)

### Web & Frameworks
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, Vite, Zustand, TanStack Query, Radix UI primitives.
- Styling: Token-based Vanilla CSS, CSS Modules, CSS Custom Properties (Zero-runtime overhead).
- Backend: FastAPI, Node.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, Asyncio.
- Desktop: Electron, MPV IPC.

### Persistence & Storage
- SQLite (WAL mode, embedded zero-config persistence)
- PostgreSQL (Production relational workloads)
- Redis / Upstash (Distributed caching and sliding-window rate limiting)

### Quality, Security & Testing
- Testing: Vitest, Playwright, React Testing Library, Pytest.
- Static Analysis: ESLint, TypeScript strict mode, Stylelint, CSpell, Ruff, Pyright, Pyrefly.
- Security Best Practices: Strict Content Security Policy (CSP), CSRF double-submit token verification, encrypted audit trails, rate limiting, and RFC 9309-compliant robots/SEO directives.
